title: Happy Ghast Control
description: Give your Happy Ghast Speed and Storage. With Permissions, Configs, and more..
body:
### Mach9Games Studio ## Happy Ghast Controls ![Banner artwork for Happy Ghast Controls, showing a cute blocky Happy Ghast flying through the sky with a WASD-style arrow key layout for movement controls.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f9bb0a69af9e7bb5b74e2954260ace4947e5aef.jpeg)

**Happy Ghast Controls** is a lightweight Fabric mod that makes riding and managing Happy Ghasts easier. It adds smoother Happy Ghast riding controls, configurable speed, Cargo Harness storage, server permissions, and update notices. ## Features | Feature | Description | | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Cargo Harnesses | Craft storage harnesses in every vanilla harness color. | | Cargo Harness Texture | Adds a custom texture for Cargo Harness Happy Ghasts. | | Happy Ghast Storage | Adds 54-slot storage to Cargo Harness Happy Ghasts. | | Storage access | Open storage by sneak-right-clicking, or with your inventory key when installed on the client. | | Movement toggle | Press `SHIFT + Forward`, default: `W`, while riding to toggle auto-forward. | | Speed control | Change Happy Ghast riding speed with `/hg speed`. | | Toggle duration | Set how long auto-forward stays active. | | Permissions | Control storage, crafting, speed commands, and update notices. | | Update notices | Notify players when a newer compatible Modrinth version is available. | ## Cargo Harness Craft a Cargo Harness using a vanilla harness and 2 chests: | Crafting | Variants | |---|---| | | | Happy Ghasts wearing a Cargo Harness get their own storage. If the harness is removed, the stored items spill out. ## Controls ![Banner artwork for Happy Ghast Controls, showing a cute blocky Happy Ghast flying through the sky with subtle movement and speed-control effects.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/086f98545f41ae194dd3be58a59afd5739e27313.jpeg) | Key | Action | | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | | `SHIFT + Forward`, default: `W` | Toggle Happy Ghast auto-forward on or off | | Inventory key, default: `E` | Open Happy Ghast Storage while riding, if the client is installed | V0.2.1 *The toggle changed from `SHIFT` to `SHIFT + Forward` to avoid conflicts with descending while riding.* ## Commands | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `/hg help` | Shows Happy Ghast Controls help | | `/hg about` | Shows mod/version information | | `/hg speed` | Shows the current Happy Ghast speed multiplier | | `/hg speed ` | Changes the Happy Ghast speed multiplier | | `/hg timer` | Shows the current Shift toggle duration | | `/hg timer ` | Changes how long the Shift toggle stays active | `/happyghast` also works as the longer command alias. V0.2.0 *`/happyghost` depricated (will disapear in the future)* ## Defaults | Setting | Default | |---|---| | Speed multiplier | `1.25x` | | Toggle duration | Infinite, until toggled off again | ## Requirements | Requirement | Version | |---|---| | Mod loader | Fabric | | Minecraft | `26.1.2` | | Java | `25` or newer | | Dependency | Fabric API | ## ⚙️ Installation Install the mod like any other Fabric mod: 1. Install Fabric Loader. 2. Install Fabric API. 3. Put Happy Ghast Controls in your `mods` folder. 4. Launch the game. ## Where To Install Happy Ghast Controls uses the same file for servers, clients, and singleplayer. | Install location | What you get | | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Server | Happy Ghast storage, Cargo Harness crafting, speed settings, permissions, and update notices. | | Client | Riding controls, Cargo Harness texture, clearer visuals, and the inventory-key storage shortcut. | | Singleplayer | Both server and client features. | Permissions are always checked by the server. Installing the mod on your client does not bypass server permissions.
